programme.title: Stagecoach Outlaws
programme.desc: Cowboy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) enrages saloon owner Steve Kirby (Stanford Jolley) when he thwarts a bank robbery by Kirby's crew. But Kirby has more schemes up his sleeve. He sends his men to bust brutish outlaw Matt Brawley (Bob Kortman) out of jail for a new heist. When a case of mistaken identities leads to the bandits freeing harmless Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) instead, he decides to play along to help Billy. However, the real Brawley soon arrives to cause trouble.

programme.title: The Hawk of Powder River
programme.desc: Vivian Chambers (Jennifer Holt) has a secret identity. She moonlights as "the Hawk," a villain who leads a gang of criminals. Vivian's uncle owns a ranch, and she wants to commandeer it. After her uncle catches a glimpse of the Hawk's secret lair, Vivian kills him and decides to go after his daughter, Carole (June Carlson), as well. Now it's up to Deputy Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to save Carole and defeat Vivian and her bandit minions.

programme.title: Man From Oklahoma
programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) and his partner (George "Gabby" Hayes) help a woman (Dale Evans) in distress.

programme.title: The Navajo Kid
programme.desc: Gunslinger Tom Kirk (Bob Steele) is searching for the man who killed his adoptive father and the true identities of his biological parents. He rides into the town where the murder took place, but there Sheriff Landon (Edward Cassidy) warns him against vigilantism. This doesn't stop Tom from pursuing poker player Honest John (I. Stanford Jolley), who has the victim's ring. However, when John is shot with the same rare ammo that killed the elder Kirk, Tom realizes the murderer is still at large.

programme.title: Chappaquiddick
programme.desc: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious and scandalous events forever alters Kennedy's political legacy -- and ultimately changes the course of presidential history.

programme.title: All Souls Day: Dia de los Muertos
programme.desc: When young lovers Joss (Travis Wester) and Alicia (Marisa Ramirez) arrive in a small Mexican town, they inadvertently stumble upon an attempted human sacrifice. Eventually they find their way to the local sheriff, Blanco (David Keith), and begin to piece together the supernatural puzzle, which involves the dead rising from their graves. As the village's dark history is revealed, it becomes clear that the evil stems from the immortal Vargas Diaz (Danny Trejo), who must be stopped at any cost.

programme.title: Blackheart
programme.desc: A con artist (Richard Grieco) leaves his partner for dead and pursues a woman (Fiona Loewi) with a $10 million inheritance.

programme.title: Played
programme.desc: Rival gangs hire a British thug (Mick Rossi), who was imprisoned for eight years, to complete a hit in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Flaming Bullets
programme.desc: A criminal syndicate has been illegally freeing convicts, only to murder them after authorities offer reward money for the fugitives' scalps. Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) are charged with catching the thugs, and they hit upon a plan: Dave will get himself put in jail, the thugs break him free and Tex and Panhandle will arrest them. But, when the criminals realize the Rangers are closing in, things turn deadly.

programme.title: The Westward Trail
programme.desc: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann.

programme.title: Susanna Pass
programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

programme.title: Bar 20 Justice
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy gets the drop on some miners robbing ore from the heroine's mine.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.

There, Caxton kills a sheriff, and, with the help of crooked local saloon boss Clark Varney (Douglas Fowley), installs a conspirator in the dead lawman's place. Meanwhile, Eddie comes across Martha Devery (Peggy Wynn), the distressed daughter of the former sheriff, and promises her he will bring the villains to justice.

After Lopez insists that the mysterious Maria (Dolores Castle) wear the precious gem, Eddie becomes suspicious that she may be in league with the gang that recently stole some of Lopez's gold and killed one of his men.

Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. programme.title: The Comedy of Terrors
programme.desc: Waldo Trumbull (Vincent Price) is an amoral undertaker in 19th-century New England who takes to murdering people to have enough cash to support his drinking habit. Desperate for money after a widow stiffs him for a burial, Trumbull and his assistant, Gillie (Peter Lorre), decide to kill the wealthy Mr. Black (Basil Rathbone), their landlord, to whom they're indebted. But murdering Black proves to be quite a challenge, as he seems to keep recovering from death every time they do him in.

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp 2: Unhappy Campers
programme.desc: Angela Baker (Pamela Springsteen), a psychotic transsexual, escapes from a mental hospital and surfaces at a summer camp as a counselor who lectures her teenage charges on proper moral behavior. Those teens who break her strict rules -- from the camp chatterbox or a sex-obsessed girl to the boys who are peeping Toms -- are murdered by the impostor in various gruesome ways. As more campers go missing, intrepid counselor Molly (Renee Estevez) begins to piece together the truth.

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp 3: Teenage Wasteland
programme.desc: Psychotic Angela (Pamela Springsteen) is itching to do what she does best: slaughter dozens of teenage campers. As luck would have it, the previous site of her murders has been renamed and converted into an experimental summer camp meant to bring together privileged and lower-class teens. On the day the youths are boarding the buses to camp, Angela runs over a potential camper with a garbage truck and assumes her identity. Once she has infiltrated the camp, the real terror begins.

programme.title: Dr. Heckyl and Mr. Hype
programme.desc: The kind but physically disfigured Dr. Heckyl is so distraught over his continual failures with the opposite sex that he decides to end his life by overdosing on an extra-strength diet drink. Strangely, he doesn't die -- he transforms into slick stud Mr. Hype. Unfortunately, Hype has an insatiable thirst for blood, and he ends up killing his dates before any romance unfolds. He soon sets his sights on the sweet Coral, who secretly loves Heckyl, but not Hype.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. programme.title: Marshal Law
programme.desc: In the wake of a devastating earthquake, a former U.S. marshal (Jimmy Smits) fights thugs terrorizing an isolated Los Angeles community.

programme.title: Killing Streets
programme.desc: When he's informed that his twin brother has died in Beirut, basketball coach Craig Brandt (Michael Paré) flies to Lebanon to investigate for himself. His brother was a U.S. Marine who, according to the military, died in an explosion during an anti-terrorist operation. At the U.S. Embassy, Craig meets with Charles Wolf (Lorenzo Lamas), who backs up the official story. Nevertheless, Craig has the uncanny feeling that his brother is still alive -- and that he's the only one who can save him.

programme.title: Desert Sands
programme.desc: Sheik El Zanal (Keith Larsen) and his faithful sister, Princess Zara (Marla English), plot revenge on an outpost of the French Foreign Legion 15 years after their parents are murdered in cold blood by men dressed as legionnaires. After the brutal massacre of a patrol unit, the fort's newly assigned commander, Capt. David Malcolm (Ralph Meeker), battles the cunning El Zanal and his henchmen while waiting for reinforcements -- and finding himself unexpectedly attracted to the beautiful Zara.

programme.title: Cast a Giant Shadow
programme.desc: In this fact-based film, distinguished U.S. Army Col. David Marcus (Kirk Douglas) is enlisted by the Israelis to perform the difficult task of preparing their fledgling nation for battle against the Arabs. Before long, he feuds with the local leaders, quits his post and goes back home to his pregnant wife (Angie Dickinson) in the United States. However, Marcus, who is Jewish himself, soon has a crisis of faith and decides to return to duty to help the untrained Israelis form an army.

Little does she know that Franz is more than a doll maker. Really, he is really a merciless mad scientist who fights off loneliness by shrinking people and forcing them to serve as his living dolls. But, when he shrinks Sally and her new beau, they refuse to be his playthings and escape into a dangerous world that towers over them.

programme.title: The Monster That Challenged the World

These bloodthirsty sea snails are gobbling up anyone who sets foot in the water. And when the creatures move on to land in search of wider hunting grounds, they launch a reign of terror that threatens to spread across the whole country. Humanity's only hope rests on a crew of intrepid scientists and Lt. Cmdr. John Twillinger (Tim Holt).

Returning the distinct lack of hospitality, the extraterrestrial uses his otherworldly powers to turn those he encounters into mindless drones. Elliot tries to stop the creature before everyone is turned into a zombie.

programme.desc: Fashion designer Marian (Melissa Gilbert) meets the man of her dreams, dashing lawyer Edward Moran (Joe Penny). programme.title: The Assassin

programme.title: We Still Kill the Old Way
programme.desc: A teacher (Gian Maria Volonte) falls for a woman (Irene Papas) whose husband was recently murdered on a hunting trip.

programme.title: A Kiss Before Dying
programme.desc: Amoral Bud Corliss (Robert Wagner) pursues young heiress Dorie Kingship (Joanne Woodward) in the hopes of getting his hands on the fortune amassed by her father (George Macready). But after Dorie succumbs to Bud's charms and becomes pregnant as a result, he fears she'll be cut off by the family and murders her in a fashion that makes it look as if the poor girl committed suicide. When Bud tries to cozy up with Dorie's grieving sister, Ellen (Virginia Leith), she begins to suspect his intentions.

programme.title: Vice Squad
programme.desc: Capt. Barnaby (Edward G. Robinson), leader of the Los Angeles Vice Squad, is trying to track down the murderers of a beat cop. To do this, he pulls some strings to coerce help from Mona Ross (Paulette Goddard), the madam behind a local escort ring. Using this lead and further help from an informant, Barnaby hunts down a pair of bank robbers he suspects are the killers. However, the criminals prove to be hard to catch, so Barnaby must stay determined.

programme.title: Tomorrow Is Forever
programme.desc: In 1918, Elizabeth MacDonald (Claudette Colbert) learns with shock that her husband, John Andrew (Orson Welles), has been killed in the war. Elizabeth bears John's son and eventually marries her kindly boss. Unknown to her, John has survived but is horribly disfigured and remains in Europe. Years later, on the eve of World War II, Elizabeth refuses to agree to her son's request to enlist and is stunned when an eerily familiar stranger named Kessler arrives from abroad and becomes involved.

programme.title: Separate Tables
programme.desc: During the off-season at the Beauregard Hotel, the secrets of some guests are exposed. Lovely but vulnerable Ann Shankland (Rita Hayworth) travels to the hotel in hopes of starting over with her ex-husband, John (Burt Lancaster), but she does not know that he is already engaged to Pat Cooper (Wendy Hiller), the manager of the hotel. Meanwhile, Mrs. Railton-Bell (Gladys Cooper) and her daughter Sibyl (Deborah Kerr) discover the hidden truth about war veteran Major Pollack (David Niven).

programme.title: Lady of Vengeance
programme.desc: When publisher William Marshall (Dennis O'Keefe) learns his young ward Melissa Collins (Eileen Elton) has committed suicide, he sets in motion a plan to murder the man who drove her to kill herself. Mistakenly believing that singer Larry Shaw (Vernon Greeves) is his intended target, Marshall unwittingly seeks help from the man who actually broke Melissa's heart, criminal Emile Karnak (Anton Diffring). When Marshall learns the truth, however, he turns his efforts toward Karnak instead.

programme.title: For Those Who Think Young
programme.desc: Youth is in full swing at Oceancrest College, and no place swings harder than the Silver Palms, the choice hot spot for student Sandy (Pamela Tiffin) and her pals. Sandy's uncle, Woody (Woody Woodbury), who performs a comedy act at the club, has his livelihood threatened when wealthy conservative Edgar Cronin (Robert Middleton) attempts to shutter the wild hangout for good. This makes things especially sticky for Cronin's grandson, Ding (James Darren), who's trying to get a date with Sandy.

programme.title: Just for Kicks
programme.desc: A stranger tries to help twin brothers (Cole Sprouse, Dylan Sprouse) who play for a winless soccer team.

programme.title: Ski Party
programme.desc: In this musical, college classmates Todd Armstrong (Frankie Avalon) and Craig Gamble (Dwayne Hickman) head out on a group ski vacation, and agree that if they're going to get girlfriends, they need to understand how women think. So when they arrive at the ski lodge, Todd and Craig dress up as young women and pal around with female classmates. Though this provides a bit of insight, the plan goes awry when a male classmate falls for the female version of Craig and pursues him all over the resort.

programme.title: Top Banana
programme.desc: Tyrannical TV star Jerry Biffle (Phil Silvers) wants to boost the sagging ratings for his comedy series. What better way to do that than by casting a couple of hot young bodies -- Sally Peters (Judy Lynn) and Cliff Lane (Danny Scholl) -- as eye candy for the viewing public? The plan gets complicated when Jerry falls for Sally, who really loves Cliff. Adapted from the hit Broadway musical, "Top Banana" is notable for filming the actual stage production on the original sets.

programme.title: Beach Party
programme.desc: Dolores (Annette Funicello) and Frankie (Frankie Avalon), attractive young surfers in Southern California, are just out for a good time. Their relaxed lifestyle fascinates Professor Sutwell (Bob Cummings), an anthropologist who decides to study the social lives of teens. A series of beach-themed films would follow the blueprint set by this one, which hinges on romantic rivalries, rugged motorcyclists, an attempted crime and plenty of handsome people.

programme.title: Sergeant Deadhead
programme.desc: After setting off a rocket during a parade, Sergeant Deadhead (Frankie Avalon) is sent to a guardhouse by his commanding officer, General Fogg (Fred Clark). While attempting to escape, Deadhead accidentally boards a rocket and launches himself into space with a chimpanzee. Deadhead and the chimpanzee are eventually recovered by the air force, but upon his return to Earth, it becomes clear that Deadhead has undergone an unbelievable personality change.

programme.title: De Sade
programme.desc: The 18th-century French marquis (Keir Dullea) recalls his sadomasochistic experiments and goes to jail for lewd behavior.

programme.title: Clambake
programme.desc: A wealthy young man, Scott Heyward (Elvis Presley) wants to experience life outside his privileged upbringing. When he meets Tom Wilson (Will Hutchins), an earnest water-skiing instructor, Scott offers to trade places with him. As Tom warms up to the good life, Scott gets used to a less luxurious existence and falls for Dianne Carter (Shelley Fabares), who, ironically, is hoping to meet a rich man. Sticking to his humble guise, Scott tries to woo Dianne without the benefit of his true status.

programme.title: Matchless
programme.desc: A New York journalist (Patrick O'Neal) plays global spy with an ancient ring that makes him invisible.

programme.title: Wild in the Streets
programme.desc: Archetypal 1960s musician Max Frost (Christopher Jones) lends his backing to a Senate candidate who wants to give 18-year-olds the right to vote, but he takes things a step further than expected. Inspired by their hero's words, Max's fans pressure their leaders into extending the vote to citizens as young as 15. Max and his followers capitalize on their might by bringing new issues to the fore, but, drunk on power, they soon take generational warfare to terrible extremes.

programme.title: Extremities
programme.desc: Marjorie (Farrah Fawcett) manages to fight off a rapist and flee to safety. Because her attacker got away and Marjorie has no proof of the crime, police officers tell her there is little they can do. Because Marjorie's attacker also stole her purse, she fears that he will use its contents to track her down. programme.title: Monkey on My Back
programme.desc: In this fact-based film, star prizefighter Barney Ross (Cameron Mitchell) puts his career on hold to fight in World War II. He soon distinguishes himself through his courageous service, but later becomes infected with malaria. He is sent home and treated with morphine, to which he soon becomes addicted. As he descends further into the throes of his deadly habit, his courageous wife, Cathy (Dianne Foster), vows to help her husband kick his addiction before it kills him.

programme.title: Hostile Witness
programme.desc: A highly regarded English lawyer, Simon Crawford (Ray Milland) is devastated when he finds out that his daughter has been killed in a hit-and-run accident. The driver is still at large, and Crawford becomes obsessed with tracking the person down. After a surprising turn of events, Crawford is put on trial for the death of a neighbor, who also happened to be a judge. Initially represented by a younger lawyer, Crawford eventually defends himself in court, despite not having an alibi.

programme.title: The Night They Raided Minsky's

But trouble arises when partners in a comedy duo compete for Rachel's affections.

Freed from the mental hospital where he had been committed, the recovered Toombes and screenwriter Herbert Flay (Peter Cushing) intend to revive his most popular character, Dr. Death, for a television series. But the dead bodies start piling up -- all of them killed in ways that mimic the victims in Toombes' films -- and to clear his name he must find the real killer.

programme.title: The First Power

programme.title: The Fall of the House of Usher
programme.desc: Based on the classic story "The Fall of the House of Usher" by Edgar Allan Poe and directed by legendary filmmaker Roger Corman, this thriller features Vincent Price as Roderick Usher, a man who believes his family to be cursed by incurable madness. programme.title: The Ghost of Sierra de Cobre

programme.title: Cotton Comes to Harlem
programme.desc: Harlem's African-American population is being ripped off by the Rev. Deke O'Malley (Calvin Lockhart), who dishonestly claims that small donations will secure parcels of land in Africa. When New York City police officers Gravedigger Jones (Godfrey Cambridge) and Coffin Ed Johnson (Raymond St. Jacques) look into O'Malley's scam, they learn that the cash is being smuggled inside a bale of cotton. But the police, O'Malley and lots of others find themselves scrambling when the money goes missing.

programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: After a robbery in Harlem turns into a scene of mass murder, promising young black police officer William Pope (Yaphet Kotto) is assigned to the case, along with surly, prejudiced Italian-American cop Frank Mattelli (Anthony Quinn). The pair clashes during their tense investigation as they try to track down the three suspects and apprehend them. Also searching for the fugitives is ruthless mobster Nick D'Salvio (Tony Franciosa), who will stop at nothing to retrieve the stolen money.

programme.title: The Children of Times Square
programme.desc: The mother (Joanna Cassidy) of a runaway (Brandon Douglas) tries to save him from a cocaine dealer's (Howard E. Rollins Jr.) youth gang in New York.

programme.title: Hurricane Streets
programme.desc: A stark portrait of kids living on the edge, "Hurricane Streets" focuses on one teenager's fight to change the circumstances of his life. programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: Walter Whitney is a successful executive who resides in an upscale Southern California suburb. Like all of his friends and neighbors, Walter is white, and he is shocked when he learns he has a son he never knew about -- black teen Roger Porter (Denzel Washington). Despite his surprise, Walter welcomes Roger into his home; unfortunately, the less accepting Mrs. Whitney (Susan Saint James) boots both of them out of the house, and Walter's racist boss fires him, leaving him in a tough spot.

programme.title: The Wild Pair
programme.desc: An FBI agent (Beau Bridges) and a detective (Bubba Smith) tie ghetto drugs and mayhem to a colonel's (Lloyd Bridges) white supremacists.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Aspiring actor and hot-dog stand employee Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) catches the ire of his grandmother (Helen Martin) for auditioning for a role in the regrettably titled exploitation film Jivetime Jimmy's Revenge. When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson).

programme.title: Census Taker
programme.desc: Fed up with his intrusiveness, members of a family shoot a census taker and try to hide his body from a detective.

programme.title: Blind Rage
programme.desc: A CIA agent (Fred Williamson) in a pancake house closes the case of five blind bank robbers in the Philippines.

programme.title: Catch the Heat
programme.desc: An agent (Tiana Alexandra) works as an exotic dancer to nab a drug smuggler (Rod Steiger) who hides heroin in breast implants.

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: A convicted murderer leads a band of men through shark-infested waters in an attempt to escape the fortress prison.

programme.title: Penitentiary
programme.desc: Hitchhiker Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone gets a lift from prostitute Linda in her van and travels with her to meet her clients. After a fight breaks out with the men, Gordone is knocked unconscious and awakens to find he has been wrongly charged with murder. As a way to protect himself in prison, Gordone starts fighting other inmates. This leads him to discover an underground boxing tournament, with the top prize being a prison release.

programme.title: Penitentiary II
programme.desc: Boxer "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) tries keeping his nose clean after being paroled from prison. He could box, but he doesn't want to go back to that life. He works as a deliveryman instead, and starts seeing his old girlfriend, Clarisse (Eugenia Wright). But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead.

programme.title: Pressure Point
programme.desc: Frustrated by his inability to help an African-American patient who hates whites, a psychiatrist (Peter Falk) asks his superior (Sidney Poitier) to release him from the case. The superior relates a case from his own past during World War II when he treated a young Nazi (Bobby Darin) who despised blacks. Explaining the tragic results of the case, the older psychiatrist encourages his younger colleague not to be swayed by the patient's attitude, to remain objective and to stick with his treatment.

programme.title: The Wilby Conspiracy
programme.desc: English engineer Jim Keogh (Michael Caine) and black anti-apartheid activist Shack Twala (Sidney Poitier) go on the run together in the 1970s South Africa after falling foul of the police. Aided by Shack's lawyer, Rina (Prunella Gee), the two attempt to make their way to Cape Town where Shack hopes to return a diamond stash to the African National Congress and in turn seek help from the Congress' leader, Wilby (Joe De Graft). Unbeknownst to the pair, they are being followed.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Growing up on the tough streets of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) has his life made even harder by John McKinney (Art Lund), a crooked cop who breaks the boy's leg, crippling him for life. Drawing on his anger at the racism he faces on a daily basis, Tommy grows up to become the crime kingpin of Harlem. Now that he has the power, he aims to take down New York's Mafia bosses -- and also get bloody revenge on his nemesis, McKinney, no matter what the cost.

programme.title: Bucktown, U.S.A.
programme.desc: After his brother's death, Duke Johnson (Fred Williamson) travels to a small Southern town to organize his brother's funeral. During his stay, he decides to revive his brother's nightclub business. However, this venture quickly uncovers the thinly veiled racism and corruption that run rampant in the town. Duke and his friend Aretha (Pam Grier) face demands for bribes and violence from the police. With the arrival of Duke's pal Roy (Thalmus Rasulala), the situation only escalates.

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: Hotheaded laborer B.J. Hammer (Fred Williamson) can't go long without ending up in a fight, and, after he comes out on top in a particularly impressive workplace scuffle, word of his brawling skills makes its way to Davis (Bernie Hamilton), a top boxing manager. Hammer is hired by Davis and begins a lucrative career in the ring, only to find out that his new employer wants him to throw a fight and take part in other illicit activities. Hammer reacts to this news violently, and the feud is on.

programme.title: Youngblood
programme.desc: An angry Vietnam veteran (Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs) leads a Los Angeles street gang in a war on drug dealers.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Give Me Your Life
programme.desc: As Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Harriet prepare to leave for their honeymoon, Forbes (Carl Weathers) clashes with a charismatic cult leader (Peter Fonda) who has arrived in Sparta.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: A Matter of Justice
programme.desc: The trail of a serial killer leads the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) and police chief (Carl Weathers) to a prominent citizen in Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Who Was Geli Bendl?
programme.desc: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: By Duty Bound
programme.desc: A murder suspect (Corbin Bernsen) works for a businessman running against Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) for sheriff.

programme.title: Cast a Long Shadow
programme.desc: Chip (John Dehner), a ranch foreman, approaches aimless hard-drinker Matt Brown (Audie Murphy) in a New Mexico bar. The owner of Chip's ranch has died and left Matt his land, thinking the troubled drifter may be his long-estranged son. Initially, Matt plans on selling the ranch, but then decides to keep it, hoping to impress his ex-lover, Janet (Terry Moore). The ranch, however, turns out to be in foreclosure, forcing Matt and Chip to come up with a plan to pay off their debt to the bank.

programme.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
programme.desc: The year is 1908, and aging adventurer Sam Longwood (Lee Marvin) and his gang of crooked cowboys have been cheated out of a big score by their own cohort, Jack Colby (Robert Culp). After years of searching, Sam finally tracks Colby down and decides to take revenge against his former accomplice. Sam regroups his old circle of grifters, and they hatch a scheme to get their hands on Colby's fortune; however, nothing seems to go smoothly for these ramshackle scam artists.

programme.title: Sonora Stagecoach
programme.desc: The Trail Blazers (Hoot Gibson, Bob Steele, Chief Thundercloud) escort an innocent man to a fair trial.

programme.title: Gun Belt
programme.desc: After giving up his gunfighting ways, Billy Ringo (George Montgomery) has settled down with his new wife, Arlene (Helen Westcott), on a ranch he's just purchased with his brother, Matt (John Dehner), and nephew Chip (Tab Hunter). But when Matt tricks him into participating in a bank robbery -- and frames him as the ringleader -- Billy is forced to go on the run from lawman Wyatt Earp (James Millican), and once again take up his guns against his former rival, Ike Clinton (William Bishop).

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: After learning that all the poker games in town cheat their players, Bat starts his own game, but a crooked sheriff arrests him and bans him from poker.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: A marksman's wife convinces him not to take a greedy casino owner up on an agreement to kill Bat, but the casino owner looks for a way to force the murder by any means necessary.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: Angered over several recent mine disasters, Sheriff Hollister wages a campaign for mine safety legislation with the aid of Editor Claiborne of the Tombstone Epitaph; in the process, they uncover a clever ruse to discredit the safety campaign.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: Adam Kirby witnesses a murder in the livery stable; then makes the mistake of shooting off his mouth about it, leading to the killer coming after him; Sheriff Hollister baits a trap with Kirby and waits to trap the killer and save Kirby.

programme.title: Blazing Guns
programme.desc: The governor sends the Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson) to tame a cow town.

programme.title: California
programme.desc: A Mexican aristocrat (Michael Pate) dies leading troops against his half brother's rebels (Jock Mahoney) in old California.

programme.title: The Brass Legend
programme.desc: Sheriff Wade Addams is engaged to Linda Gipson and searching for an elusive killer, Tris Hatten. Linda's little brother, Clay, happens upon Tris' hideout one day, and immediately notifies Wade, who arrests the killer. Despite efforts to keep Clay's involvement a secret, the details come out and Clay's life is threatened. Wade must protect Clay while sidestepping attempts on his own life by Tris' henchmen.

programme.title: Cannon for Cordoba
programme.desc: During the 1912 Mexican Revolution, rebel leader Hector Córdoba (Raf Vallone) and his bloodthirsty revolutionaries slip across the Texas border and liberate a number of cannons from a U.S. Army fort. Under direct orders from General Pershing (John Russell), Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) heads into Mexican territory to face down Córdoba and get back the American cannons with the help of Mexican military officer Antonio (Gabriele Tinti) and alluring local Leonora (Giovanna Ralli).

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: Thanks to his prowess with a gun, Dave Robles (Anthony Quinn) makes a place for himself in Mesa, becoming sheriff after out-dueling several gunfighters in a single day. But Robles, a Mexican, seethes over the town's racism, and is warned by kindly nurse Estella (Katy Jurado) that without his gun, he would not last very long. That theory is put to the test when the new sheriff injures his wrist fighting with Ed Bannister (Peter Whitney), who upon learning about it, challenges Robles to a duel.

programme.title: Cast a Long Shadow
programme.desc: Chip (John Dehner), a ranch foreman, approaches aimless hard-drinker Matt Brown (Audie Murphy) in a New Mexico bar. The owner of Chip's ranch has died and left Matt his land, thinking the troubled drifter may be his long-estranged son. Initially, Matt plans on selling the ranch, but then decides to keep it, hoping to impress his ex-lover, Janet (Terry Moore). The ranch, however, turns out to be in foreclosure, forcing Matt and Chip to come up with a plan to pay off their debt to the bank.

programme.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
programme.desc: The year is 1908, and aging adventurer Sam Longwood (Lee Marvin) and his gang of crooked cowboys have been cheated out of a big score by their own cohort, Jack Colby (Robert Culp). After years of searching, Sam finally tracks Colby down and decides to take revenge against his former accomplice. Sam regroups his old circle of grifters, and they hatch a scheme to get their hands on Colby's fortune; however, nothing seems to go smoothly for these ramshackle scam artists.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: When pirates stage a daring holdup of the riverboat Dakota Queen and steal $10,000 from Bat, along with other passengers' valuables, Bat takes advantage of their leader's gluttony using a barrel of rare cheeses.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: Mace Pomeroy offers Bat a small fortune to command his forces in his railroad war against Gen. Moran.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: When a U.S. Marshal is ambushed while bringing in outlaw Kyle Dodge, he turns his captive over to Sheriff Hollister just before he dies, with the cryptic warning to trust nobody; forewarned, the Sheriff forestalls a clever attempt to free Dodge.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: In order to trap an outlaw gang, the Epitaph reports that a gang member is turning state's witness; the outlaw dies of his wounds, but his death is kept secret; in a bold move, the gang kidnaps Claiborne and offers to exchange him for the outlaw.

programme.title: The Iron Sheriff
programme.desc: When his son Benjie is accused of killing a stagecoach driver, Sheriff Sam Galt is convinced his boy is innocent. On a quest to clear his son's name, Galt spares no expense in hiring lawyers. While Galt's position as town sheriff raises suspicions of police misconduct, he makes it clear he won't stand in the way of the law. But that certainty is thrown into doubt when Galt goes on a search for the real murderer -- and makes a startling discovery.

programme.title: The Winds of Autumn
programme.desc: An 11-year-old Quaker boy sets out across the grasslands of 1880s Montana to avenge his family's deaths.

programme.title: Barquero
programme.desc: Jake Remy (Warren Oates) and his band of mercenaries shoot their way through a tiny border town, planning to escape with their plunder across the river into Mexico. They dispatch a few men to neutralize the local ferryman, Travis (Lee Van Cleef), but he and flinty mountain man Phil (Forrest Tucker) foil the scheme. By the time Jake reaches the river, Travis has already taken everyone from the town to the Mexican side. He refuses passage to the mercenaries, and a lengthy standoff ensues.

programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: Brandt Ruger (Gene Hackman) is a rich cattle rancher. He has a bad relationship with his wife, Melissa (Candice Bergen), whom he treats like a possession. While Brandt is away from home on a hunting trip, Frank Calder (Oliver Reed), a brazen outlaw, kidnaps Melissa and holds her for ransom. Frank, however, treats Melissa better than her own husband does, and before long she begins to develop feelings for him. When Brandt returns, he's enraged and vows to take violent revenge against Frank.

programme.title: The Scalphunters
programme.desc: Illiterate fur trapper Joe Bass (Burt Lancaster) is coerced by some Kiowa Indians into trading his haul for a well-educated, escaped slave named Joseph Lee (Ossie Davis). Bass seeks to track the Indians and recover his treasure, while Joseph wants to travel to Mexico, where slavery is illegal. Their plans are complicated by the arrival of a band of scalphunters, led by Jim Howie (Telly Savalas), who want to kill the Indians, claim the furs and resell the black man.

programme.title: The Gunfight at Dodge City

Bat purchases and renovates a rundown saloon, attracting the notice of Regan's henchmen. A shooting during the saloon's opening-night celebration causes Bat to pursue his own political vendetta against Regan and attempt to clean up the town's corruption once and for all.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: Sheriff Clay Hollister sends for a woman lawyer to settle a dispute between a mine owner and a local businessman; Clay is unaware that one of the men has been stealing gold and putting it in blocks of ice.

programme.title: Fort Massacre
programme.desc: After his cavalry company is decimated by an Apache attack, Vinson takes charge and tries to lead his remaining men to safety. Unfortunately, his pathological hatred of Native Americans causes him to commit rash acts that put his troops in jeopardy. The enlisted men, especially the rebellious McGurney, question Vinson's leadership and even his morality, but the soldiers must stick together if they wish to make it through Apache lands.

programme.title: Trooper Hook
programme.desc: Wanted for killing a squadron of soldiers, Apache Chief Nanchez (Rudolfo Acosta) is finally captured by Sgt. Clovis Hook (Joel McCrea), who discovers among Nanchez's prisoners Cora Sutliff (Barbara Stanwyck), who had been missing for several years. Sutliff has not only fully integrated into the Apache way of life, she also has a son with Nanchez. Now Hook wants to transport her back to her old way of life, but Nanchez isn't willing to let his son be taken from him.

programme.title: Escort West
programme.desc: In the wake of the Civil War, ex-Confederate soldier Ben Lassiter and his 10-year-old daughter, Abbey, are traveling through Nevada when they cross paths with sisters Martha and Beth Drury. Although Martha is embittered because her fiancé was killed by a Confederate during the war, she is forced to trust Ben when a band of Native Americans tries to attack the sisters, and the soldier offers his protection.

programme.title: The Glory Guys
programme.desc: Inspired by the Battle of the Little Bighorn, this Western follows a selfish military leader, Gen. Frederick McCabe (Andrew Duggan), who unfeelingly throws his soldiers into dangerous battle situations, and the soldiers who must follow his orders. While waiting to be sent into combat, two of the men -- Harrod (Tom Tryon) and Rogers (Harve Presnell) -- find themselves in the midst of a love triangle as they both pursue the heart of the beautiful Lou Woddard (Senta Berger).

programme.title: Fort Bowie
programme.desc: A group of Apaches visits a cavalry fort in hopes of laying down their weapons and coming to a peace agreement, but Maj. Wharton (J. Ian Douglas), wanting to make a name for himself, orders his men to massacre them. Meanwhile, Col. Garrett (Kent Taylor) believes his flirtatious wife is sleeping with Capt. Thompson (Ben Johnson), so he tries to get rid of the captain by ordering him to track Victorio (Larry Chance), a notorious Apache warrior who's plotting a large-scale attack on the fort.

programme.title: Southwest Passage
programme.desc: Edward Beale (Rod Cameron) and his caravan are en route to California as part of the U.S. Cavalry's initiative to utilize camels as cargo carriers for desert treks. Beale and his men join up with an escaped bank robber, Clint McDonald (John Ireland), who is impersonating a doctor. When one of Beale's men discovers McDonald's fraud, he blackmails the thief for a share of the bank loot. But then a far more menacing threat emerges in the form of American Indian warriors.

programme.desc: From worse to terrible -- Civil War veteran Matt Weaver (George Segal) arrives in New Mexico worn down from combat, only to discover his family plot has been requisitioned and sold by cutthroat property developer Sam Brewster. In 480 B.C. a state of war exists between Persia, led by King Xerxes (Rodrigo Santoro), and Greece. At the Battle of Thermopylae, Leonidas (Gerard Butler), king of the Greek city state of Sparta, leads his badly outnumbered warriors against the massive Persian army. Though certain death awaits the Spartans, their sacrifice inspires all of Greece to unite against their common enemy.

When Beck's employer, Walker (William Lucking), sends him to the Amazon to locate Walker's cocky son, Travis (Seann William Scott), Beck discovers a population controlled by a tyrannical treasure hunter (Christopher Walken). To survive, Beck and Travis must work together, without their affections for a mysterious rebel (Rosario Dawson) getting in the way.

programme.title: Tous en choeur
programme.desc: Une Marche avec Anne-Élisabeth Bossé, une sortie à la cabane à sucre et un concert final réunissant les quatre choeurs. Les choristes montent sur scène, fiers du chemin parcouru et tournés vers l'avenir.

programme.title: Et si c'était toi?
programme.desc: Jeune retraitée, la pétillante Élodie, 41 ans, cherche une relation sérieuse; lors de ses trois rendez-vous, elle se promène dans un champ avec Geneviève, s'adonne à une activité nautique avec Nancy, et grille des guimauves au bord du feu avec Sarah.

programme.title: La clé Deschamps
programme.desc: Atterri du Nouveau-Brunswick, c'est une belle surprise qu'attend Guy Godin à son arrivée chez Martin ; on entre dans cet univers musical teinté d'un parfum acadien où se rencontrent passion, détermination et conviction au son d'un bon classique.

programme.title: Divergentes
programme.desc: Comment élever un enfant quand on peine déjà à s'occuper de soi ; Coco et Naadei abordent les défis de la maternité ; Kim Rusk ouvre les portes de son quotidien de maman ; Coco rencontre Lucilla, mère d'un garçon autiste et elle-même sur le spectre.

programme.title: Les eaux calmes
programme.desc: La vie de Solène, 13 ans après qu'un plongeon maladroit lui a sectionné la moelle épinière et paralysé le corps. Grâce à la puissance d'une décennie d'images, les spectateurs assistent à son fascinant retour à la surface, alors qu'elle fonde une famille avec son compagnon.

programme.title: Style sur mesure
programme.desc: Atteinte de paralysie cérébrale depuis la naissance, Claudine rêve de se voir sous un nouveau jour et gagner en confiance ; elle souhaite mettre en lumière la belle jeune femme qu'elle est avec un style éclaté, coloré et féminin.

At the center of this community are the Duprees, a powerful and prestigious multi-generational family that is the very definition of Black royalty. But behind these pristine walls and lush, manicured gardens are juicy secrets and scandals waiting to be uncovered. And those that live outside these gates are watching closely. programme.title: La malédiction d'Oak Island
programme.desc: Au large des côtes de la Nouvelle-Écosse se trouve une petite île mystérieuse. Vers la fin des années 1700, des empreintes étranges marquent le début d'une quête. Qu'est-ce qui se cache sous Oak Island? La chasse au trésor a coûté jusqu'ici des millions de dollars et a impliqué des dizaines de spéculateurs, ingénieurs, personnalités connues comme Franklin D. Roosevelt. Tous ceux qui ont tenté de percer le mystère sont restés sur leur appétit. Les frères Rick et Marty Lagina du Michigan veulent à tout prix décoder les secrets de l'île. Marty a dépensé une fortune pour acheter l'accès à l'île. Ce riche magnat du pétrole est prêt à déployer la technologie et l'équipement nécessaires pour creuser comme jamais auparavant.

programme.title: Zombie Cars: sauvés de la scrap
programme.desc: En 1973, la crise du pétrole favorise l'arrivée massive de petites voitures étrangères en Amérique du Nord. Les constructeurs d'ici se font prendre au dépourvu avec leurs gros modèles et doivent réagir vite. General Motors, en déclin depuis l'échec de sa Chevrolet Vega, mise tout sur le développement accéléré d'une petite voiture économique : la Chevette. Rémi-Pierre nous fait découvrir le modèle qui a sauvé GM et rencontre une fan, pilote de course, qui a conservé sa Chevette par amour.

programme.title: Transmission impossible
programme.desc: Après avoir considéré une retraite bien méritée, Raymond réalise qu'il ne peut se passer de transiger des voitures ; il fait l'acquisition d'un nouveau bureau qu'il nous présente fièrement.

programme.title: Transmission impossible
programme.desc: Yannick s'intéresse à un Duster à la carrosserie impeccable, mais Jennifer remarque que le numéro de série est écrit à la main ; au volant, Raymond et Marie-Hélène se rendent en Estrie faire l'acquisition d'un Challenger décapotable.

programme.title: Transmission impossible
programme.desc: Après plus d'un an de travail à faire renaître un Superbird, Michel livre aujourd'hui le célèbre wing car à son client Marc Hamilton ; chez Raymond, Alain et Jocelyn mettent la touche finale à la restauration d'une Pontiac GTO 1971 The Judge ; Yanick et Jennifer accourent chez le collectionneur André Doré, qui, après des décennies à assembler une collection de plus de 100 voitures classiques, vient de décider de s'en départir.

programme.title: Bécanes de rêve

programme.title: Zombie Cars: sauvés de la scrap
programme.desc: En 1973, la crise du pétrole favorise l'arrivée massive de petites voitures étrangères en Amérique du Nord. Les constructeurs d'ici se font prendre au dépourvu avec leurs gros modèles et doivent réagir vite. General Motors, en déclin depuis l'échec de sa Chevrolet Vega, mise tout sur le développement accéléré d'une petite voiture économique : la Chevette. Rémi-Pierre nous fait découvrir le modèle qui a sauvé GM et rencontre une fan, pilote de course, qui a conservé sa Chevette par amour.

programme.title: Transmission impossible
programme.desc: Après avoir considéré une retraite bien méritée, Raymond réalise qu'il ne peut se passer de transiger des voitures ; il fait l'acquisition d'un nouveau bureau qu'il nous présente fièrement.

programme.title: Transmission impossible
programme.desc: Yannick s'intéresse à un Duster à la carrosserie impeccable, mais Jennifer remarque que le numéro de série est écrit à la main ; au volant, Raymond et Marie-Hélène se rendent en Estrie faire l'acquisition d'un Challenger décapotable.

programme.title: Transmission impossible
programme.desc: Après plus d'un an de travail à faire renaître un Superbird, Michel livre aujourd'hui le célèbre wing car à son client Marc Hamilton ; chez Raymond, Alain et Jocelyn mettent la touche finale à la restauration d'une Pontiac GTO 1971 The Judge ; Yanick et Jennifer accourent chez le collectionneur André Doré, qui, après des décennies à assembler une collection de plus de 100 voitures classiques, vient de décider de s'en départir.

programme.title: Chasseurs de voitures
programme.sub-title: Trésors de la Seconde Guerre mondiale

programme.title: AvGeek

programme.title: Bécanes de rêve

programme.title: Soirée canadienne
programme.desc: Chansons à répondre, gigues et rigodons; le meilleur du folklore québécois animé par Louis Bilodeau.

programme.title: Michèle tout simplement
programme.desc: On découvre en toute intimité la vie de la chanteuse et comédienne Michèle Richard; de sa première prestation sur film à l'âge de dix ans jusqu'à l'acquisition de sa nouvelle résidence dans les Laurentides; Michèle se raconte en mots et en images.

programme.title: Noël chez les Cooper
programme.desc: Le film suit le clan Cooper alors que quatre générations se réunissent pour leur traditionnel réveillon de Noël. Lorsqu'une série de visiteurs et d'événements inattendus viendront semer le désordre, les Cooper devront redécouvrir ce qui les unit afin de retrouver l'esprit des fêtes.

programme.title: Flics en service
programme.desc: Deux inspecteurs de la police de New York affrontent un gangster obsédé par ses souvenirs quand ils sont appelés pour retrouver une carte de baseball de grande valeur.

programme.title: Live: Sports 30
programme.desc: Les plus récents dénouements dans le monde du sport. On analyse en profondeur les résultats des dernières 24 heures dans toutes les disciplines. programme.desc: À Las Piedras, sorte de ville frontière à la population hybride, le travail manque. Chacun noie, sous le soleil, son ennui dans l'alcool. Non loin de la ville, le SOC, une compagnie pétrolière américaine, fait la pluie et le beau temps des embauches. Un jour, elle réclame quatre volontaires pour conduire deux camions chargés de nitroglycérine afin de souffler l'incendie d'un puits situé à cinq cents kilomètres.

programme.title: Révolution sur glace: la série du siècle
programme.desc: On explore les histoires intrigantes et inédites derrière la Série du siècle qui a opposé, pour la première fois en 1972, les meilleurs joueurs des deux plus grandes nations du hockey, le Canada et l'Union soviétique. La façon dont l'événement s'est produit, son impact dramatique sur les Canadiens et son héritage sont racontés par des personnes dont on entend rarement ou jamais parler: des diplomates, des journalistes, d'anciens joueurs de la LNH et des partisans du Canada.

programme.desc: Martin et Stefano ont chaud en cuisine; les équipes s'activent pour terminer leurs plats; les clients ont le coeur à la fête et sont impatients de goûter à la cuisine des candidats; l'heure du vote est difficile, car les deux équipes se sont surpassées.

programme.title: Indomptables
programme.desc: Philippe veut trouver qui a voulu se débarrasser de Michel afin de prouver son innocence; Michel demeure convaincu que Philippe veut sa peau et il menace de dévoiler ce qu'il sait.

programme.title: Laurent Paquin: crocodile distrait
programme.desc: Dans ce cinquième spectacle solo, Laurent Paquin affirme ne pas avoir le bonheur facile ; ça ne l'empêche pas pourtant de réfléchir sur la question du bonheur : qui est heureux ? Pourquoi ? Comment ? Et pour combien de temps ?

programme.title: La relève
programme.desc: Dans le coeur du Morvan, le dernier vétérinaire du coin, Nico, met les bouchées doubles afin de sauver ses patients, sa clinique ainsi que sa famille. Lorsque son associé et mentor Michel lui annonce sa décision de prendre sa retraite, Nico sait que la passe la plus difficile est imminente. Or, la relève trouvée par Michel, Alexandra, est fraîchement diplômée et ne semble pas d'avis à rester dans son village d'enfance. On se demande donc si Nico réussira à la convaincre de rester.

programme.title: La vie devant elles
programme.desc: Une ancienne actrice hollywoodienne résidant en Angleterre se rend en France pour assister aux funérailles d'un vieil amant ; là-bas, elle rencontre une admiratrice de son âge et s'embarque pour de folles aventures.

Personne n'est décidé à rendre les armes et la guerre sera totale.

programme.title: Le dernier loup
programme.desc: À la fin des années 60, un étudiant de Beijing se rend en Mongolie pour s'imprégner de la vie sauvage. Il intègre une communauté nomade dont le chef l'initie à l'importance de la nature. Un jour où il s'est écarté de son chemin, Chen Zhen tombe sur une meute de loups. Après s'en être sorti indemne, il se met à mieux connaître cette espèce. Mais les loups ne sont pas les bienvenus et les autorités cherchent à les éliminer en décimant leur nourriture et leurs progénitures.

programme.title: Los secretos de La Roja: campeones del mundo
programme.desc: El 11 de julio de 2010 quedará para siempre como una de las fechas más importantes del fútbol español. Ese día, la selección española consiguió su ansiada primera Copa del Mundo. Este documental narra el camino hacia la victoria de la Roja.

programme.title: Andrés Iniesta, El Héroe Inesperado
programme.desc: Una mirada íntima a la vida y carrera de Andrés Iniesta, abarcando el inicio de su trayectoria en La Masía, la academia juvenil del FC Barcelona, hasta su ascenso meteórico a la fama jugando para el Barça y la Selección Española, donde sus habilidades en el campo llevaron al conjunto nacional a llevarse el Mundial en 2010, y su llegada al Vissel Kobe en Japón. programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Tras ejecutar su último encargo, Angelo empieza a notar que algo no va bien: su mente comienza a fallar justo cuando las dos vidas que ha mantenido separadas durante años -la de asesino a sueldo y la de padre de familia- empiezan a colisionar.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Después del intento de asesinato contra su hija, Angelo le revela que el hombre responsable de la muerte de su madre ha salido de prisión antes de tiempo. Mientras el FBI lo interroga, Angelo inicia su propia investigación en secreto.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Dutch encarga a Angelo eliminar a un agente de Asuntos Internos que amenaza con desmantelar su organización. Mientras tanto, Maria intenta protegerse tras el ataque sufrido, y la presión aumenta cuando el FBI empieza a sospechar que Angelo oculta algo.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Convencido de que 'El Barquero' está detrás del ataque a su hija, Angelo pospone un encargo para ir tras él. Al mismo tiempo, el FBI avanza en una investigación que empieza a acercarse peligrosamente a su doble vida.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Durante una misión, Angelo revive un momento clave de su pasado: el instante en que descubrió que su hermano padecía Alzheimer, una revelación que le obligó a tomar una decisión que cambiaría su vida para siempre.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Atrapado entre recuerdos fragmentados, Angelo comienza a cuestionar su propia percepción de la realidad. Mientras planea un asesinato de alto riesgo en un escenario público, una investigación policial se acerca cada vez más a descubrir sus secretos.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Angelo descubre que uno de sus trabajos del pasado puede ser clave para desenmascarar a su enemigo. Al mismo tiempo, nuevas pistas amenazan con exponer su doble vida ante quienes más quiere.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Revelaciones inesperadas sacuden los cimientos de la vida de Angelo y ponen en riesgo a su familia. Mientras tanto, Joe recibe una oportunidad que podría cambiar su destino.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Tras un giro impactante, Angelo se lanza en una carrera contrarreloj para proteger a sus seres queridos de la amenaza implacable de 'El Barquero', cuya violencia se intensifica.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Fin de temporada. Las dos vidas de Angelo colisionan definitivamente en un enfrentamiento explosivo con su enemigo. En un final cargado de tensión, todo queda al descubierto en una resolución tan intensa como emocional.

programme.title: One Zoo Three
programme.desc: Hoy en One Zoo Three, las Leyendas del Zoo están de celebración. Hay mucho que preparar para organizar un evento muy especial. Los hermanos están calentando motores para presentar a algunos de los habitantes más longevos.

programme.title: Dulce Navidad
programme.desc: Este documental viaja a Nueva York, Reino Unido y Suecia para visitar tres de las tiendas de caramelos más grandes del mundo durante una de las épocas más especiales del año. Un viaje navideño a través de algunos de los destinos más dulces del planeta.

programme.title: Superagente Hitpig
programme.desc: Hitpig es un cerdo cazarrecompensas que trabaja para una gran corporación capturando fugitivos. Su vida cambia cuando le asignan capturar a Pickles, un simpático elefante que ha escapado de una feria en busca de un lugar donde le quieran.

programme.title: Cruyff
programme.desc: Estrella del fútbol. Genio de los goles imposibles. Fuerza imparable dentro y fuera del campo. Johan Cruyff no fue solo un jugador: fue un visionario que traspasó los límites del deporte. Este es su retrato definitivo.

programme.title: Leo talks
programme.desc: Pocas cosas despiertan tanta pasión como la música. Leo recorre sus géneros, rituales y rarezas, desde los casetes y los karaokes hasta los festivales multitudinarios y la inteligencia artificial, encontrando humor en cada compás.

programme.title: Ilustres ignorantes
programme.desc: La actriz Nikki García y el humorista Xavi Puig son los invitados de este capítulo de Ilustres en el que debaten sobre 'Los finales' ¿Qué final les hubiera gustado cambiar en su vida: de una relación, una actuación, una comida.?

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: Hace ya muchas generaciones que los Miyagi y los Han están unidos por la amistad y las artes marciales.

programme.title: DeportePlus+ Domingo
programme.desc: Un lugar donde cabe todo el deporte que se juega en el planeta de la mano de Juanma Castaño. La emoción y la pasión con las mejores imágenes, las previas, los resúmenes, los testimonios y el análisis de nuestros expertos.

programme.title: Liga ACB
programme.desc: La Liga Endesa apuesta por el espectáculo. La máxima competición española de clubes cuenta, como es habitual, con una liga regular de 34 jornadas. Los ocho mejores equipos pelean por el título en unos exigentes playoffs. El Valencia Basket defiende corona.

programme.title: Sicarios
programme.desc: Un tiroteo tiene lugar a la salida de una comunión en San Pedro de Alcántara, Marbella. La investigación destapa una peligrosa banda de sicarios asentada en la Costa del Sol. Disparos, explosiones, ajustes de cuentas y mucha violencia.

programme.title: Sicarios
programme.desc: Los sospechosos son profesionales, escurridizos y peligrosos. Las primeras investigaciones llevan el rastro hasta Malmö, Suecia. Las cámaras de seguridad serán claves para seguir avanzando en el caso. ¿Qué relación hay entre Marbella y Malmö?

programme.title: Sicarios
programme.desc: Asesinatos, bombas y mucha violencia. La banda actúa como si nada ni nadie pudiera detenerlos. Cambian constantemente de coche, de casa, de colaboradores y de país, pero la policía española y sueca los tiene cada vez más localizados.

programme.title: John Wick (Otro día para matar)
programme.desc: John Wick es un asesino a sueldo retirado que vuelve a la acción después de que un jefe mafioso haya puesto precio a su cabeza y le haya robado todo lo que le quedaba tras la muerte de su esposa. Además, el sicario contratado para acabar con él es Marcus, un amigo y excompañero suyo que le recomendó que se apartara del mundo criminal. El estadounidense Chad Stahelski se estrenó como director con este filme de acción que resultó ser toda una sorpresa en taquilla cosechando casi 70 millones de euros (teniendo en cuenta que el presupuesto no llegó a los 20 millones). Stahelski, con un largo historial como especialista en películas de acción, volvió a coincidir con Keanu Reeves, al que curiosamente dobló en las escenas más peligrosas de 'Matrix'. Además de Reeves, el elenco de la cinta está repleto de nombres conocidos como los de Alfie Allen (Theon Greyjoy en 'Juego de Tronos'), Willem Defoe ('Platton'), Michael Nyqvist ('Saga Millenium: Los hombres que no amaban a las mujeres'), Ian McShane ('Piratas del Caribe: En mareas misteriosas') y Adrianne Palicki ('Friday Night Lights').

programme.title: John Wick (Otro día para matar)
programme.desc: John Wick es un asesino a sueldo retirado que vuelve a la acción después de que un jefe mafioso haya puesto precio a su cabeza y le haya robado todo lo que le quedaba tras la muerte de su esposa. Además, el sicario contratado para acabar con él es Marcus, un amigo y excompañero suyo que le recomendó que se apartara del mundo criminal. El estadounidense Chad Stahelski se estrenó como director con este filme de acción que resultó ser toda una sorpresa en taquilla cosechando casi 70 millones de euros (teniendo en cuenta que el presupuesto no llegó a los 20 millones). Stahelski, con un largo historial como especialista en películas de acción, volvió a coincidir con Keanu Reeves, al que curiosamente dobló en las escenas más peligrosas de 'Matrix'. Además de Reeves, el elenco de la cinta está repleto de nombres conocidos como los de Alfie Allen (Theon Greyjoy en 'Juego de Tronos'), Willem Defoe ('Platton'), Michael Nyqvist ('Saga Millenium: Los hombres que no amaban a las mujeres'), Ian McShane ('Piratas del Caribe: En mareas misteriosas') y Adrianne Palicki ('Friday Night Lights').

programme.title: Saturday Night Live
programme.desc: El actor y cómico estadounidense John Mulaney vuelve a presentar SNL por séptima. Phoebe Bridgers actúa como invitada musical de SNL por segunda vez. La ganadora de varios Premios Grammy se encuentra actualmente de gira con su último álbum.

programme.title: Saturday Night Live: detrás de cámaras
programme.desc: Durante mucho tiempo el programa tenía un elenco y cuando todos se marchaban, empezaban de cero. Pero de repente, se inició el proceso en el que la gente se quedaba y ahí surgieron las audiciones. Este episodio muestra los procesos de audición de 'SNL'.

programme.title: Saturday Night Live: detrás de cámaras
programme.desc: 'More Cowbell' fue emitido en el año 2000, escrito por Will Ferrell y Donnell Campbell. Fue un éxito instantáneo y pasó a formar parte de la cultura popular americana de manera irremediable. Este episodio muestra el proceso de creación del mítico sketch.

programme.title: Saturday Night Live: detrás de cámaras
programme.desc: Una mirada entre bastidores al proceso de escritura de 'Saturday Night Live', desde la creación del guion hasta la emisión del programa, capturando la creatividad y el caos de una semana dentro de la sala de guionistas de 'SNL'.

programme.title: Saturday Night Live: detrás de cámaras
programme.desc: En 1985, después de una década en antena, SNL estaba a punto de ser cancelado. Este episodio explora la undécima temporada, un año crucial en el que se reajustó la dirección del programa y se consolidó su ADN con Lorne Michaels al timón.

programme.title: Oasis: Supersonic
programme.desc: Oasis, la legendaria banda liderada por los hermanos Noel y Liam Gallagher, se convirtió en un icono de la década de los 90 y logró definir el estilo pop británico de toda una era. Película documental que repasa la historia de Oasis, mítico grupo de estilo 'britpop' asociado, irremediablemente, a la arrolladora personalidad de sus líderes: los hermanos Gallagher. Con la ciudad de Manchester como origen, Oasis se convirtió en un éxito a escala global, aunque fuera a costa de la relación de Liam y Noel. A modo de curiosidad, hay que decir que 'Supersonic', la canción que pone título a este filme, fue el primer tema que publicaron y 'tan solo' logró el puesto número 31 en la lista de éxitos del Reino Unido.

programme.title: Pequeños hábitos, grandes beneficios
programme.desc: Comer remolacha ayuda a la mejora del rendimiento físico y tiene una potente acción antiinflamatoria.

programme.title: Informe Robinson
programme.desc: El Cambados de Sito Miñanco. A finales de los años ochenta, el equipo de fútbol de la pequeña localidad de Cambados llegó a convertirse en el tercero de Galicia. El esplendor del Xuventude Cambados comenzó a partir del momento en que Sito Miñanco se hizo cargo de él. A base de dinero, consiguió sacarlo de la Regional Preferente para ponerlo a las puertas de la Segunda División. Treinta años más tarde, y con Sito Miñanco de nuevo detenido por narcotráfico, el ejemplo de aquel equipo se ha convertido en el mejor reflejo de lo que fueron los años de esplendor del tráfico de cocaína en Galicia. Una época que dejó cicatrices que aún no se han cerrado.

programme.title: Marihuana
programme.desc: Cataluña. Cuartel General de los Mossos d'Esquadra en Sabadell. Unos 600 agentes se preparan para ejecutar la mayor operación del año contra una organización criminal que está llegando a dominar un barrio entero de Girona a través de la violencia.

programme.title: Marihuana
programme.desc: Granada, finales de marzo de 2026. En un chalé de la urbanización de Los Tablazos, las fuerzas de seguridad se encuentran una espectacular plantación de marihuana con la última tecnología custodiada por un solo jardinero a sueldo de la Mafia Albanesa.

programme.title: Perdita Durango
programme.desc: Una atractiva mujer sin escrúpulos y un traficante mexicano emprenden un viaje por el desierto de Arizona, dispuestos a cumplir el encargo de un capo mafioso: transportar un cargamento de fetos desde México hasta Las Vegas.

programme.title: Dakar: carrera contra el desierto
programme.desc: Durante décadas, el Rally Dakar ha sido mucho más que una carrera: es la máxima prueba de resistencia, habilidad y pasión en el mundo del motor. Este documental ofrece un acceso sin precedentes al corazón del Dakar 2023, acompañando a sus protagonistas.

programme.title: La pista del Tenis. Nitto ATP Finals
programme.desc: El prestigioso torneo con el que concluye el circuito ATP reúne a los ocho mejores jugadores del año, quienes buscan el título de 'Maestro'.

programme.title: Finales ATP
programme.desc: Los Masters 1000 son los torneos más importantes después de los Grand Slam y forman parte del ATP Tour. Se celebran en Norteamérica, Europa y Asia y se juegan en pista rápida y tierra batida. El Campeón consigue 1000 puntos para el ranking ATP.

programme.title: La pista del Tenis. Nitto ATP Finals
programme.desc: El prestigioso torneo con el que concluye el circuito ATP reúne a los ocho mejores jugadores del año, quienes buscan el título de 'Maestro'. La cita, del 15 al 22 de noviembre en Turín, cuenta con dos españoles: Carlos Alcaraz (gran favorito junto a Zverev) y el debutante Rafa Jódar.

programme.title: Ilustres ignorantes
programme.desc: La actriz Nikki García y el humorista Xavi Puig son los invitados de este capítulo de Ilustres en el que debaten sobre 'Los finales' ¿Qué final les hubiera gustado cambiar en su vida: de una relación, una actuación, una comida.?

programme.title: Blindado
programme.desc: Un lujoso coche aparcado y con las puertas abiertas en el blanco fácil de Eddie Barrish, un hombre sin dinero que entra en él para robar. Pero cuando quiere salir, no puede. Está encerrado y el coche es una trampa.

programme.title: Una vida en diez fotos
programme.desc: Britney Spears fue una de las mayores estrellas del pop de su generación. Esta es la historia de cómo, en una carrera marcada por la imagen pública y la exposición mediática, luchó por tomar el control de su música, de su vida y de su propia imagen.

programme.title: El regreso de Demi Moore
programme.desc: Demi Moore protagonizó un regreso espectacular en 2024 con 'La sustancia', película que consolidó sus 45 años de carrera en Hollywood. Históricamente etiquetada como una actriz comercial, la intérprete tuvo que lidiar con los rígidos cánones de belleza.

programme.title: Informe Plus. La fe de Vicky
programme.desc: La mejor futbolista joven de Europa. Dos veces premio Kopa. A sus 20 años, Vicky López tiene ya un palmarés futbolístico impresionante, con el FC Barcelona y con la selección española.

programme.title: Leo talks
programme.desc: ¿Por qué nos da tanto miedo aburrirnos? Leo Harlem analiza nuestra necesidad constante de estar siempre entretenidos: desde el móvil hasta los deportes más soporíferos, pasando por los compañeros de trabajo, las parejas y los hobbies más absurdos.

programme.title: Passengers
programme.desc: La nave estelar Avalon, en viaje de 120 años hacia el planeta colonia de Homestead II, navega en piloto automático con 5.000 pasajeros y 258 tripulantes en estado de hibernación. James Preston, uno de los pasajeros, despierta del letargo forzado.

programme.title: UEFA Youth League
programme.desc: Las futuras estrellas del fútbol continental protagonizan la Youth League. El torneo de la UEFA da la oportunidad a los juveniles de los clubes que participan en Champions de mostrar su talento más allá de sus países. El Real Madrid se impuso en 2026.

programme.title: Bernabéu
programme.desc: Santiago Bernabéu (1895-1978) fue, además de jugador, capitán y entrenador, el presidente del Real Madrid durante 35 años. Un hombre comprometido con su club que sentó sus bases.

programme.title: Aprende inglés con Vaughan en Realmadrid TV
programme.desc: Programa que ofrece a los espectadores la oportunidad de aprender inglés de la mano del profesor Richard Vaughan. El espacio pretende introducir al público de lleno en el idioma, tanto desde el punto de vista gramatical como desde el analítico.

programme.title: Conecta Informativo
programme.desc: Un profundo repaso a la actualidad que ha generado el Real Madrid en las últimas horas, tanto a nivel institucional, como en los equipos de fútbol, de baloncesto y de la cantera. En el informativo también se escucharán a los protagonistas de las noticias.

programme.title: Misión arenas ardientes
programme.desc: AÑO: 1966 TÍTULO ORIGINAL: Missione sabbie roventi DURACIÓN: 90 min. PAÍS: Italia-España DIRECCIÓN: Alfonso Brescia REPARTO: Howard Ross, Roberto Camardiel, Helga Liné, Anna Maria Polani, Petro Tordi SINOPSIS: Año 1500. Los turcos están a punto de lanzar un ataque para apoderarse del pueblo de Homs. Pero Karin, un agente secreto de Yemen, lo descubre. Así que es enviado a un fortín de la frontera para tratar de evitarlo.

PAÍS: Estados Unidos DIRECCIÓN: Ernie Barbarash REPARTO: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Scott Adkins, Kevin Chapman, Bianca Brigitte Van Damme SINOPSIS: Los dos mejores asesinos del mundo, desconocidos el uno para el otro, se aliarán para acabar con un cártel de la droga protegido por la Interpol. Uno movido por la venganza y el otro por la recompensa, tendrán que luchar contra criminales y agentes corruptos para lograr su objetivo.

programme.desc: Un hombre se dirige a un hospital para reunirse con su mujer, que está a punto de dar a luz. Sin embargo, al llegar al aparcamiento, un desconocido a punto de pistola le obliga a irse de allí.

programme.title: Forbidden Apple
programme.desc: يسلط مسلسل (التفاحة المحرمة) الضوء ضمن أحداثه على عالم رجال الأعمال والثراء الفاحش، والصراع الذي يصنعه الحب من جانب، وسيطرة المال على البشر من جانب آخر. The events highlight the world of businessmen and extreme wealth, the conflict created by love on the one hand, and the control of money over people on the other.(n)

programme.title: حادث قلب
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل في قالب من الرومانسية والدراما حول قصة فتاة ثرية تعيش حياة سعيدة، لكن وقوع حادث سير لها سيغيّر حياتها ويقلبها رأسًا على عقب، فماذا سيحدث لها. A rich girl, who’s leading a quiet, happy life, gets into an accident that turns her whole world upside down.(n)

programme.title: Cranberry Sorbet
programme.desc: تعيش (دوجا) مع والدتها وأختها، ثم تنشأ علاقة حب قوية بينها وبين (فاتح) الذي ينتمي لطبقة أرستقراطية، لكن تقف هذه الاختلافات الطبقية والثقافية عائقًا أمام حبهما المتوهج. Doga lives with her mother and sister, and then an intense romance develops between her and Fatih, who belongs to an aristocratic class, but these class and cultural differences stand in the way of their love.(n)

programme.title: بهو الست لميا
programme.desc: في إطار كوميدي، تتمحور الأحداث حول شخصية الست لميا ومساعدها أبو شادي، والفندق الذي تديره، حيث يجمع شخصيات متنوعة من خلفيات اجتماعية وثقافية مختلفة. تنشأ بينهم سلسلة من المفارقات اليومية والمواقف الطريفة المشوقة، والتي تعكس تفاصيل الحياة اليومية بأسلوب ساخر ومرح. The story revolves around Lamia, her assistant Abu Shadi, and the hotel she manages—a place that brings together a diverse group of characters from various social and cultural backgrounds. A series of daily complications and amusing situations unfold among them, reflecting the intricacies of everyday life.(n)

programme.title: اسمي ملك
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل حول ملك التي تحاول بناء حياة جديدة مع عائلتها، كما تجاهد من أجل البقاء مع أطفالها الثلاثة. Gaziantep-born Melek is married and has three kids. Her life is turned upside down when her spouse leaves her alone and takes the kids with him.

programme.title: صار الوقت
programme.desc: برنامج سياسي اجتماعي أسبوعي، يقدمه الإعلامي والمحامي (مرسال غانم) على شاشة ال MTV، والذي يتعرض للعديد من القضايا السياسية التي تهم المواطنين في البلاد. A weekly social and political program, presented by the journalist and lawyer Marcel Ghanem on MTV Lebanon, which deals with many political issues of concern to citizens in the country.

programme.title: اسمي ملك
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل حول ملك التي تحاول بناء حياة جديدة مع عائلتها، كما تجاهد من أجل البقاء مع أطفالها الثلاثة. Gaziantep-born Melek is married and has three kids. Her life is turned upside down when her spouse leaves her alone and takes the kids with him.

programme.title: مجنون فيكي
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل في إطار رومانسي حول قصة حب (كلارا) وهى سيدة لديها مجلة عن الموضة، تقع في حب شريكها في المجلة، ورغم الصعوبات التي تواجه قصة حبهما، إلا أن صبرها وكفاحها قد يشكلان أمل لنجاح هذه القصة. Clara, a woman who owns a fashion magazine, falls in love with her partner. Despite the challenges they face, her determination and her patience are her best bet to make the relationship work.(n)

programme.title: وين كنتي ج1
programme.desc: تدور أحداث القصة الدرامية عن زواج رجل في الستين من عُمره، و(نسرين) الفتاة اﻷصغر منه بسنواتٍ كثيرة، مما يشكِّل ذلك بمثابة صدمة للعائلة، وبشكل خاص لابنه (جاد) وحبيبته (سيلا)، فيبدأ الصراع المتمثل في محاولات للتخلص من الزوجة الشابة، وطردها من مزرعة العائلة. A drama revolving around the marriage of a 60-year-old man, and Nisreen, who is many years younger, which causes a shock to the family, especially to his son Gad and his love Sella, and the conflict begins in the attempts to get rid of the young wife and drive her out of the family farm.(n)

programme.title: على صفيح ساخن
programme.desc: يعود هلال بعد سفر طويل في الخارج، ويحاول أن يستعيد ما له وﻷخوته من أموال لدى عمه زهير الطاعون الذي يعيش بين الخرائب، لكنه يكتشف أن المهمة ليست سهلة على اﻹطلاق. Hilal returns after a long time of being abroad, and tries to recover his and his siblings' money from his uncle, Zuhair El Taoon, who lives among the ruins, only to realize that his mission is not that simple.(n)

programme.title: آسر
programme.desc: بعد خيانة أصدقائه والمرأة التي أحبها، يجد (مجد) نفسه خلف القضبان. لكنه لا ينهزم بملامح جديدة وهوية مختلفة، يعود (آسر) لهدف واحد: الانتقام، وذلك في إطار من الدراما والتشويق. After getting betrayed by his friends and the woman he loved, Majd finds himself behind bars but not defeated. With a new face and a different identity, Aser returns with one goal in mind: vengeance.(n)

programme.title: على صفيح ساخن

programme.title: لولا الحب
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل حول الفتاة مسا (نادين الراسي) التي تعمل وسط مجال إعلامي كبير وتستغل تلك الوظيفة في تسليط الضوء على مجموعة من القضايا والمشاكل الهامة في المجتمع متحدية العديد من الشخصيات ذو السلطة والنفوذ.. في ذات الوقت تحاول اتخاذ قرار بشأن علاقتها غير الشرعية وحملها. The series revolves around Missa, who works in a large media field and sheds light on a range of important issues and problems in society in defiance of many figures with power and influence, while she tries to decide on her affair and pregnancy.

programme.title: علاقات خاصة
programme.desc: يجسد كل زوجين قصة درامية تتشابك أحداثها بشكل أو بأخر مع العلاقات الأخرى بدءًا من «جو» رجل الأعمال المتزوج من «ياسمين» التي تنتمي لبيئة فقيرة ليصنع منها نجمة غناء، وترتبط حياة «جو وياسمين» بـ «حسام» المتزوج من «فرح»، بالرغم من رفض أهلها لهذا الزواج بسبب فارق السن، أما «جهاد» فيقع ضحية إنتقام مزدوج من أخته «رنا» و«إياد» حبيب زوجته المستقبلية «لامار»، أمّا «تيم» فيحب «مايا» رغم اختلاف الديانة. The events of each couple's story are intertwined with other relationships, starting with Jo, a businessman married to Yasmin, who becomes a singing star. Hossam who is married to Farah. While Jehad is the victim of double revenge from his sister Rana and Eiad. As for Tayem, he's in love with Maya despite having a different religion.

programme.title: آسر
programme.desc: بعد خيانة أصدقائه والمرأة التي أحبها، يجد (مجد) نفسه خلف القضبان. لكنه لا ينهزم بملامح جديدة وهوية مختلفة، يعود (آسر) لهدف واحد: الانتقام، وذلك في إطار من الدراما والتشويق. After getting betrayed by his friends and the woman he loved, Majd finds himself behind bars but not defeated. With a new face and a different identity, Aser returns with one goal in mind: vengeance.

programme.title: وأشرقت الشمس
programme.desc: في أوائل القرن الماضي، في زمن الحكم العثماني، والمقاومة العربية، ينشأ صراع بين الشيخ (عبدالله سلامة)، ونسيبه الشيخ (خليل سلامة)، ويورثونه بعد عشرين عاما إلى (طلال بن الشيخ عبدالله)، و(جلنار ابنة الشيخ خليل)، ليزداد الكره حقدا، والقهر ظلما. قصة ثورة على التقاليد، بين حبّ ممنوع، زواج مرفوض، ونور محجوب، بين صبية جميلة إنما فقيرة، وأحد المشايخ المتحدر من عائلة إقطاعية. فكان الاستبداد وراثيا وجينيا، أب وَرَّثَ البطش والحقد لابنه، وأم ورثت القهر والعذاب لابنتها، ليعيد التاريخ نفسه، ولكن هذه المرة بوجود عنصرين مهمين: الحبّ، والانتقام، بين شاب فرض وجوده وتسلطه بعنجهية وقوة أبيه، وفتاة قرّرت الانتفاض بقوّة على أسيادها؛ لأنها لم ولن تنسى أمها وآلامها. During the Ottoman rule and the Arab resistance, a conflict arises between Sheikh Abdullah Salama, and his relative Sheikh Khalil Salama. It carries on for twenty years and gets transferred to Talal, Abdullah's son, and Jalnar, Khalil's daughter. But this time, love and revenge are joined together.
